blurb: Inside the Five Brewing Co. brews culinary inspired craft beers locally in Toledo, OH. They offer a variety of original beers, ciders, and seltzers on tap at multiple locations including a taproom at their production facility called The Fieldhouse. They also have an annual Draft Class Membership with exclusive discounts and benefits.
extraNote: Memberships valid for one year from date of purchase · Members must drink all gifted beers before membership expiration · Memberships renew automatically each year unless auto-renew disabled · Taproom at their production facility in Toledo, OH (The Fieldhouse)
